summary: Cameco filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement dated November 5, 2026 with TD Securities, CIBC and Scotia Capital (Canadian and U.S. agents) for an at-the-market program of up to US$1,000,000,000 of common shares, sold at the company's discretion via placement notices. The shares are offered under a Canadian prospectus and a U.S. F-10 registration statement. Legal consents and a press release are attached. This is an ordinary shelf takedown/ATM facility rather than a special situation; watch dilution pace and placement frequency as the arbitrage-relevant variable.
